description:
Claude on AWS Bedrock through the Anthropic SDK: the Anthropic-on-Bedrock and Mantle
        clients, which extend the direct Anthropic client and sign with the Bedrock base's AWS
        credentials, for what the SDK carries that the Converse API does not (extended thinking,
        prompt caching, Mantle's routing). Adds to nucleo-provider-bedrock, which serves Claude
        through Converse on its own. The Anthropic SDK has no native-image support, so a native
        build leaves this artifact out and reaches Claude through the base.
